name: Anyone Would Have
tagline: When it counts, you've already done it a hundred times.
epigraph: Gin, cherry, herbs and lime. One day, nobody behind the bar could make it.
glassware: large rocks glass (about 400 ml), one large ice cube
language_row: Wren's Resonance (v3): horoscope check one borderline at most; swap test distinct from *Off Duty*, *Not Only the Way*, *Next One's Mine*, *The Long Answer*, *Worth the Trip*; 4-grams clean against every pour (lint-only moves: "we have" → "on record", "a few dashes of bitters" (*Off-Label*) → "some bitters", "hazy from the lime" (*Still Yours*, *Fair Measure*) → "cloudy with lime", "The people beside you" (*Making the Calls*) avoided); no "we", "our" or bare "yours"; every he/his is Marco Dionysos or the 1913 members (Hester). ✓
sources: Studio fact cards `_studio/fact-cards/marco-dionysos.md` (Robert Simonson, *A Proper Drink* pp. 54, 60, 71–77, 173, 186; Dionysos, *FoodGPS* interview, 2010; Mark Cartwright, *World History Encyclopedia*, 2012, for the god of wine) and `_studio/fact-cards/singapore-sling.md` (*Oxford Companion* SINGAPORE SLING pdf 1803–1805, BÉNÉDICTINE pdf 256; David Wondrich, *Imbibe!* pdf 121–122, the 1913 order). Craft: *Flavor Matrix* cherry pdf 236 (consulted, no spark). Room notes: `work/hero-regular-guy/`.
names_note: **Anyone Would Have**, the room's pick (Wren's; Tomás moved to it in round 5; Hester: the name speaks to the person). Also considered: *One of Each* (Tomás's first pick, second; it opens the closing line), *Kept Going Back*, *Ready When Asked*, *Nobody Knew* (Tomás).
open_items: **Contains nuts, from two bottles (safe side):** Cherry Heering (stones unconfirmed, classed like maraschino) and Bénédictine (Oxford pdf 256 lists nutmeg; the table's `benedictine` row changed to nuts this room). A veto-free Sling would swap the cherry for claret and stop being the drink nobody could make. **The Hero family drops to eight veto-free pours.** Robin's call.

**Story swap:** the plan's lead (Phil Ward) was replaced by Marco Dionysos in round 1 (Ward fails the credit clause on *Proper* pp. 151–153). Dionysos was the Quest Seeker row's backup; that row now needs another.

**The name coincidence:** Dionysos chose his surname himself, from the Greek god (of wine, per Cartwright), the same god this place is named after. Owned in one plain clause, spelled Dionysos (the book's text spells it Dionysus). The Innocent plan set him aside over the surname. Second name coincidence in the family (Gallant). Robin's call.
**Place:** p. 72 gives no city for the restaurant; only the bookshop (Powell's) is in Portland. Guest text says "the Pacific Northwest" for the restaurant.
**Spark rule:** no *Flavor Matrix* spark, stated. The interest is the older, drier Sling (1913 order, one of each) most people have never had.
**Balance edge:** 15.1% ABV in the worst case (47% gin, low melt from one cube), justified in Checks.
**Kept out:** the Sling's Raffles/Ngiam Tong Boon origin story, the club's 1913 refusal, Waugh's coat and out-ringing contests, the Mojito (Harrington's at Enrico's), Fougner (*The Long Answer*'s).
**Image brief** says "hazy from the lime" (dossier only); the guest text says "cloudy with lime".
